content:
I dug out some old 3.5” double density floppy disks from my Atari ST days and have made some old apps of mine available as downloads. These were made between 1992 and 1994.

  • Chaos Calc 2 (fractal viewer)
  • REview (text document viewer)
  • Paint (chunky pixel art app)

Also included are some ST icons and Fuji Bar!, a companion app for the PaCifiST emulator on Windows 95 that allows you to easily manage and change .ini settings through a GUI. This was made in 1996–98.

A later DiscMaster search turned up an even older Chaos Calc 2 from May 1993, plus names of programs I had half-forgotten: a palette manager, boot tools, a menu system, a QRT ray-tracing front end.

Archived web page: gingerbeardman.com/archive/tektonix/atarist.htm

Lost to time

An artillery game called “Balance of Power”, which was a bit like QBasic Gorillas or Scorched Earth. A printer configuration utility for the Star LC-10 dot matrix printer. And some more random things.
